summary.en: Start here. The foundation every other TuyaOpen skill builds on: finding and identifying the tuyaopen-cli CLI, the --json/exit-code contract, the confirmation gate (P0 = dry-run token, license remove only; P2 = --yes; P3 ungated), skill self-discovery, and the master intent-to-skill routing table.
summary.zh-CN: 从这里开始。所有 TuyaOpen 技能共用的基础约定：CLI 定位识别、--json 与退出码契约、确认门（P0 = dry-run 派生令牌，仅 license remove 属于 P0；P2 = --yes；P3 无需确认）、技能自发现，以及总路由表。

whenToUse.en: Read first, before any other TuyaOpen skill — and whenever another skill says its task is out of scope and points here for the routing table. Not a task skill by itself.
whenToUse.zh-CN: 任何 TuyaOpen 任务的第一份读物；也用于其他技能提示「超出范围、见路由表」时。本身不是任务技能。

name.zh-CN: 嵌入式 CLI 决策表

summary.en: Which tuyaopen-cli command group covers an embedded-side intent, plus the preconditions every embedded command shares. A map, not a manual: no task steps, no flag lists.
summary.zh-CN: 嵌入式意图对应哪个 tuyaopen 命令组，以及所有嵌入式命令共享的前提条件。只是地图不是手册：不含任务步骤，不含 flag 清单。

whenToUse.en: Use when you know what you want to accomplish on the device side but not which command group owns it, or when you want the shape of the embedded CLI as a whole. Not a task skill — it routes, it does not do.
whenToUse.zh-CN: 知道要在设备侧做什么、但不确定该用哪个命令组时使用；也用于快速了解嵌入式 CLI 的全貌。本身不是任务技能，只做路由。

summary.en: Compile the current TuyaOpen project via tos.py build.
summary.zh-CN: 通过 tos.py build 编译当前 TuyaOpen 项目。

whenToUse.en: Use when the user asks to build, compile, or rebuild the active project.
whenToUse.zh-CN: 当用户要求编译、构建或重新编译当前项目时使用。

summary.en: How to author or edit a skill in this catalogue: frontmatter contract, id naming rules, payload placement, the Shortcuts-table rule, references/ progressive disclosure, out-of-scope wording, index.json registration, and version-bump rules.
summary.zh-CN: 如何在本目录新增或修改一个 skill：frontmatter 契约、id 命名规则、载荷放置、Shortcuts 表规则、references/ 渐进披露、超出范围的写法、index.json 注册、以及 version 升号规则。

whenToUse.en: Use when adding a new skill, editing an existing SKILL.md, or registering an item in skills/index.json.
whenToUse.zh-CN: 新增技能、修改现有 SKILL.md 或注册 index.json 条目时使用。

summary.en: Read/write the .tuyaopen/ project descriptor and tuyaopen.project.ini (tuyaopen-cli project *), browse the local demo catalogue (tuyaopen-cli demos *), and manage the three IDE settings (tuyaopen-cli config *) — plus the underlying tos.py new / tos.py config Kconfig tooling.
summary.zh-CN: 读写 .tuyaopen/ 项目描述符与 tuyaopen.project.ini（tuyaopen-cli project *）、浏览本地 demo 目录（tuyaopen-cli demos *）、管理三项 IDE 设置（tuyaopen-cli config *），以及底层的 tos.py new / tos.py config Kconfig 工具链。

whenToUse.en: Use when the user wants to change platform, rename, or edit project settings, create a project, bind a product, browse demos, or read/write an IDE setting (language/gitMirror/manifestsSource).
whenToUse.zh-CN: 当用户希望更换平台、重命名或修改项目级设置、创建项目、绑定产品、浏览 demo，或读写 IDE 设置（language/gitMirror/manifestsSource）时使用。

name.zh-CN: 涂鸦 IoT 平台操作

summary.en: Create products, get PID, query and configure DPs on the Tuya Developer Platform via tuya-devplat-cli.
summary.zh-CN: 通过 tuya-devplat-cli 在涂鸦开发者平台创建产品、获取 PID、查询和配置功能点（DP）。

whenToUse.en: Use when creating a Tuya product, retrieving a PID, querying or adding DPs (data points / 功能点), binding panels, releasing products, or performing any operation on the Tuya Developer Platform (iot.tuya.com).
whenToUse.zh-CN: 创建涂鸦产品、获取 PID、查询或添加功能点（DP）、绑定面板、发布产品，以及任何需要在涂鸦开发者平台（iot.tuya.com）上操作时使用。

summary.en: End-to-end IoT product development: requirements → Tuya Platform product/DP creation → complete embedded firmware. State-machine detects project state and picks up from wherever development stands.
summary.zh-CN: 端到端 IoT 产品开发：需求梳理 → 涂鸦平台建产品/DP → 完整嵌入式固件生成。状态机检测项目进度，从当前阶段继续。

whenToUse.en: Use when developer wants to build a complete IoT product from scratch, or to continue from any mid-point in the development flow.
whenToUse.zh-CN: 当开发者要从零开始做 IoT 产品，或从中途继续开发时使用。

summary.en: Hardware-aware code generation for TuyaOpen embedded projects. Reads .tuyaopen/board-context.md, confirms peripheral selection, and generates TDL-layer usage code. Includes peripheral skills for display (LVGL/raw), camera, button, and LED.
summary.zh-CN: TuyaOpen 嵌入式项目的硬件感知代码生成。读取 .tuyaopen/board-context.md，确认外设选型，生成 TDL 层使用代码。包含显示屏（LVGL/原始）、摄像头、按键、指示灯等外设 skill。

whenToUse.en: Use when the user asks to initialize or drive a hardware peripheral: display, camera, IMU, LED strip, touchpad, printer, button, joystick, PMIC, or any board hardware. Also use for 'vibe coding' or any hardware-related code generation request.
whenToUse.zh-CN: 当用户要求初始化或使用硬件外设时使用：显示屏、摄像头、IMU、LED 灯带、触摸屏、打印机、按键、摇杆、PMIC 等。也适用于 'vibe coding' 或任何硬件相关代码生成请求。

summary.en: Flash firmware, monitor serial output, and pick the right serial port via the tuyaopen CLI (firmware flash / firmware monitor / firmware list-ports), with a documented tyutool_cli fallback for reading flash, a bare hardware reset, or disambiguating a dual-serial port.
summary.zh-CN: 通过 tuyaopen CLI（firmware flash / firmware monitor / firmware list-ports）烧录固件、监控串口输出、选择正确的串口；并提供 tyutool_cli 直连兜底，覆盖读取 Flash、纯硬件复位、双串口歧义排查等场景。

whenToUse.en: Use when the agent needs to flash firmware, choose a serial port, monitor serial output, hardware-reset a device, read flash memory, or write UUID/AuthKey credentials over UART directly via tyutool_cli.
whenToUse.zh-CN: 当需要烧录固件、选择串口、监控串口输出、硬件复位设备、读取 Flash，或直接使用 tyutool_cli 通过 UART 写入 UUID/AuthKey 授权码时使用。

summary.en: Debug a running device: register firmware features as device CLI commands and drive them over the serial shell, capture serial logs non-blocking, and decode a crash dump to source file:line. Environment triage lives in tuyaopen-start.
summary.zh-CN: 调试正在运行的设备：把固件功能注册成设备 CLI 命令并通过串口驱动、非阻塞抓串口日志、把崩溃转储还原成源码文件与行号。环境诊断在 tuyaopen-start。

whenToUse.en: Use when the firmware builds and runs but behaves wrongly, when you want to exercise a feature on the device without reflashing, or when a panic dump needs decoding.
whenToUse.zh-CN: 固件能跑但行为不对、想不重新烧录就在设备上触发某个功能、或需要解码 panic 转储时使用。

summary.en: Add a new board / BSP to TuyaOpen — directory, Kconfig, drivers, and pin map.
summary.zh-CN: 为 TuyaOpen 新增开发板 / BSP：目录、Kconfig、驱动、引脚映射。

whenToUse.en: Use when the user wants to add support for a new development board or BSP (Board Support Package) to the TuyaOpen SDK — creating directories, Kconfig entries, drivers, and pin maps.
whenToUse.zh-CN: 当用户希望为 TuyaOpen SDK 新增开发板或 BSP（板级支持包）支持时使用，包括创建目录、Kconfig 条目、驱动及引脚映射。

cli.reason: 加 board 是纯 tos.py / 手工流程

summary.en: Validate C/C++ formatting, file headers (@copyright required), and forbidden Chinese characters via clang-format and check_format.py.
summary.zh-CN: 通过 clang-format 与 check_format.py 校验 C/C++ 代码格式、文件头（@copyright 必填），并禁用中文字符。

whenToUse.en: Use when the user asks to check code formatting, validate file headers, run clang-format, or verify code quality before submitting or merging.
whenToUse.zh-CN: 当用户要求检查代码格式、校验文件头、运行 clang-format 或在提交/合并前验证代码质量时使用。

cli.reason: 格式与文件头检查走 clang-format / check_files.py

summary.en: The firmware phase, end to end: hardware inquiry and pin budget, Kconfig, code generation, build, flash, authorization code, provisioning — plus the automated build-flash-monitor-analyze loop with log and error-pattern analysis.
summary.zh-CN: 嵌入式阶段的完整工作流：硬件选型与引脚预算、Kconfig、代码生成、编译、烧录、授权码、配网，外加编译—烧录—监控—分析闭环与日志/错误码分析。

whenToUse.en: Use for any device-side development, or when handed over from tuyaopen-workflow-product-dev once the platform has a PID and DPs. Also the home of the iterative debug loop.
whenToUse.zh-CN: 任何设备侧开发都从这里进；或由 tuyaopen-workflow-product-dev 在拿到 PID 与 DP 后移交过来。迭代调试闭环也在这里。

summary.en: Write UUID/AuthKey/PID to TuyaOpen devices — via tuya_config.h (source code) or serial KV flash (UART shell). Obtain authorization codes from platform.tuya.com.
summary.zh-CN: 向 TuyaOpen 设备写入 UUID/AuthKey/PID，支持源码（tuya_config.h）和串口 KV flash（UART shell）两种方式。从 platform.tuya.com 获取授权码。

whenToUse.en: Use when the user mentions device authorization, UUID, AuthKey, PID configuration, network provisioning, device pairing, or cloud connection setup.
whenToUse.zh-CN: 当用户提到设备授权、UUID、AuthKey、PID 配置、网络配网、设备配对或云连接设置时使用。

summary.en: Install dependencies and activate the TuyaOpen development environment via export.sh / export.ps1 / export.bat. Sets OPEN_SDK_ROOT and OPEN_SDK_PYTHON.
summary.zh-CN: 安装依赖并通过 export.sh / export.ps1 / export.bat 激活 TuyaOpen 开发环境，设置 OPEN_SDK_ROOT 和 OPEN_SDK_PYTHON。

whenToUse.en: Use when the user first sets up the TuyaOpen development environment, installs dependencies, or needs to activate the SDK environment. Also use when tos.py is not found or OPEN_SDK_ROOT is not set.
whenToUse.zh-CN: 当用户首次搭建 TuyaOpen 开发环境、安装依赖，或需要激活 SDK 环境时使用。当 tos.py 找不到或 OPEN_SDK_ROOT 未设置时也使用。

summary.en: Build, install the runtime, sync the DP schema, preview, manage metadata/templates, and upload the panel miniapp via the tuyaopen CLI's miniapp command group (build/install/meta/preview/sync-schema/template/upload).
summary.zh-CN: 通过 tuyaopen CLI 的 miniapp 命令组（build/install/meta/preview/sync-schema/template/upload）构建、安装运行时、同步 DP schema、预览、管理元数据/模板，并上传面板小程序。

whenToUse.en: Use when the user wants to build, preview, upload, or scaffold the miniapp from a template, sync its DP schema, set its appid, or install the MiniApp runtime — the command-line operations, not panel architecture or UI conventions.
whenToUse.zh-CN: 当用户需要构建、预览、上传小程序，从模板创建小程序，同步 DP schema，设置 appid，或安装 MiniApp 运行时——即命令行操作本身，而非面板架构或 UI 编码规范时使用。

name.zh-CN: 面板小程序开发工作流

summary.en: The panel-miniapp phase, end to end: create the miniapp and get an appid, pick a category, code, hand the user a render URL, upload, then submit / publish / bind. Owns panel architecture and the coding rules, and dispatches to the sub-skills.
summary.zh-CN: 面板小程序阶段的完整工作流：创建小程序拿 appid、选品类、写代码、把渲染链接交给用户、上传，再提审 / 发布 / 绑定。同时承载面板架构与编码铁律，并按需分派子技能。

whenToUse.en: Enter here for any panel miniapp task — it owns the phase order, the two human-only web steps (submit for review, bind to product) and their URLs, and the architecture rules. Per-command flags and gating are in tuyaopen-miniapp.
whenToUse.zh-CN: 任何面板小程序任务都从这里进 —— 阶段顺序、两个只能人在网页做的步骤（提审、绑产品）及其 URL、以及架构铁律都归它。单条命令的参数与门禁在 tuyaopen-miniapp。

summary.en: Index-first navigation and implementation constraints for Ray miniapp development. Covers Ray APIs, components, framework conventions, lifecycle, routing.
summary.zh-CN: Ray 小程序开发的索引导航与实现约束。覆盖 Ray API、组件、框架约定、生命周期、路由等核心知识。

whenToUse.en: Use for any Ray miniapp UI/page/component work, Ray API integration, device capability binding, lifecycle, routing, image-to-code, i18n, or troubleshooting.
whenToUse.zh-CN: 面板/页面/组件开发、Ray API 与设备能力集成、生命周期与路由、图片转代码、多语言与样式、或排障与升级时使用。

cli.reason: 面板开发不经 tuyaopen CLI

summary.en: Meta-first workflow for generating and modifying pages and components with Ray smart-ui.
summary.zh-CN: 基于 meta-first 工作流，协助 Ray 小程序 smart-ui 的页面与组件生成、改造、表单交互。

whenToUse.en: Use for UI scaffolding, component customization, form/feedback interactions, navigation, image-to-code, or smart-ui troubleshooting / upgrades.
whenToUse.zh-CN: UI 搭建、组件改造、表单与反馈、导航展示、图片转代码、smart-ui 排障升级时使用。

cli.reason: 面板开发不经 tuyaopen CLI

summary.en: Integrate @ray/charts-library — scene cards, DataSourceProvider, period controls, chart options helpers.
summary.zh-CN: 在 Ray 小程序中集成 @ray/charts-library：场景卡片、计量数据源、周期控件、图表配置工具。

whenToUse.en: Use when adding electricity/temperature/humidity/illuminance charts to Ray miniapp pages, building period-switching charts, or customizing with withXAxis/withTooltip.
whenToUse.zh-CN: 向 Ray 小程序页面添加用电量/温湿度/照度/计量图表、构建周期切换图表、使用 withXAxis/withTooltip 自定义配置时使用。

cli.reason: 面板开发不经 tuyaopen CLI

summary.en: Guide for capturing and structuring miniapp product requirements before implementation.
summary.zh-CN: 在动手开发前，规范化捕获并结构化小程序产品需求的指南。

whenToUse.en: Use at project kick-off when scoping a new miniapp — capturing user stories, page flows, DP usage plans.
whenToUse.zh-CN: 项目启动阶段规划新小程序时使用 —— 捕获用户故事、页面流程、DP 使用方案。

cli.reason: 面板开发不经 tuyaopen CLI

summary.en: Performance and UX guardrails for Tuya Ray miniapp panels — rendering, interaction latency, loading states.
summary.zh-CN: Ray 小程序面板的性能与体验红线，覆盖渲染、交互延迟、加载状态等关键指标。

whenToUse.en: Use during code review or optimization to validate panel performance and UX against established guardrails.
whenToUse.zh-CN: 代码评审或性能优化阶段，按既定红线校验面板的性能与体验。

cli.reason: 面板开发不经 tuyaopen CLI

summary.en: Use when the user asks to build, compile, rebuild, or clean a TuyaOS (tuyaos-legacy) app — including Chinese prompts like「编译 tuyaos xxx 应用」 「清理编译产物」「重新编译当前 app」, or English "build/compile/clean the TuyaOS app". Also use when adding custom .c/.h paths to apps/*/local.mk, wiring directories under software/TuyaOS/vendor/, or fixing missing headers / undefined references after adding sources. Runs build_app.sh/bat like Project Details Build / Clean. Do NOT use for TuyaOpen (tos.py) or flash/monitor.
summary.zh-CN: Use when the user asks to build, compile, rebuild, or clean a TuyaOS (tuyaos-legacy) app — including Chinese prompts like「编译 tuyaos xxx 应用」 「清理编译产物」「重新编译当前 app」, or English "build/compile/clean the TuyaOS app". Also use when adding custom .c/.h paths to apps/*/local.mk, wiring directories under software/TuyaOS/vendor/, or fixing missing headers / undefined references after adding sources. Runs build_app.sh/bat like Project Details Build / Clean. Do NOT use for TuyaOpen (tos.py) or flash/monitor.

whenToUse.en: Trigger on: 编译/构建/清理 + tuyaos/应用; build/compile/clean TuyaOS app; 加入源文件/头文件/local.mk/vendor 路径; add .c/.h to TuyaOS build.
whenToUse.zh-CN: Trigger on: 编译/构建/清理 + tuyaos/应用; build/compile/clean TuyaOS app; 加入源文件/头文件/local.mk/vendor 路径; add .c/.h to TuyaOS build.

summary.en: Hardware-aware code generation for TuyaOS (tuyaos-legacy) apps. Confirms pins/instance with the user, writes tkl_*/tal_* driver code under apps/<app>/src, and registers sources/headers in local.mk when needed. Canonical demos: software/TuyaOS/apps/tuyaos_demo_examples/src/examples/. GPIO、PWM、I2C、SPI、ADC、定时器、看门狗、麦克风、喇叭、DVP 摄像头、WiFi、BLE、 蓝牙、联网、STA、AP、扫网、广播、扫描、串口、外设初始化、硬件驱动、点灯、按键、 录音、播放、引脚、片上外设、TuyaOS 硬件。
summary.zh-CN: Hardware-aware code generation for TuyaOS (tuyaos-legacy) apps. Confirms pins/instance with the user, writes tkl_*/tal_* driver code under apps/<app>/src, and registers sources/headers in local.mk when needed. Canonical demos: software/TuyaOS/apps/tuyaos_demo_examples/src/examples/. GPIO、PWM、I2C、SPI、ADC、定时器、看门狗、麦克风、喇叭、DVP 摄像头、WiFi、BLE、 蓝牙、联网、STA、AP、扫网、广播、扫描、串口、外设初始化、硬件驱动、点灯、按键、 录音、播放、引脚、片上外设、TuyaOS 硬件。

whenToUse.en: Use for ANY hardware / peripheral / connectivity request on a TuyaOS project — GPIO, PWM, I2C, SPI, ADC, timer, watchdog, mic, speaker, DVP camera, Wi-Fi (STA/AP/scan/LP), BLE (peripheral/central/remote), or "make the hardware do X". Load this skill FIRST; it routes to the matching TuyaOS peripheral sub-skill. Do NOT use on TuyaOpen (tos.py / TDL) projects.
whenToUse.zh-CN: Use for ANY hardware / peripheral / connectivity request on a TuyaOS project — GPIO, PWM, I2C, SPI, ADC, timer, watchdog, mic, speaker, DVP camera, Wi-Fi (STA/AP/scan/LP), BLE (peripheral/central/remote), or "make the hardware do X". Load this skill FIRST; it routes to the matching TuyaOS peripheral sub-skill. Do NOT use on TuyaOpen (tos.py / TDL) projects.
